scope: Every checked parser rule, nested choice and optional/repetition 0/1/2 boundary; actual public compiler profiles and finite reviewed negative cases. Lexer token boundaries have separate explicit cases. This does not execute an authority.

query.behavior: Pure SELECT compilation against the explicit fixture schema. No inspection, mutations, publication or authority access.

template.behavior: Pure typed template construction; no implicit execution or binding.

mutation.behavior: Pure bounded literal mutation compilation, including atomic-statement duplicate validation; no recorded mutation.

declaration.behavior: Offline state definition compilation; wider Table syntax remains separate from executable Table compatibility.

application.behavior: Offline complete application parsing and graph validation; no publication.
